dedupe_keys.name: open5gs open source 5g nr and lte mobile core network

description: Open5GS is an open-source project for building and running your own NR (5G) and LTE mobile network core, used for private networks, testing, research and deployment according to its site. Coverage: generic software, not tied to a network or country. Format and access: source code on GitHub with documentation on open5gs.org; free to use under the open-source licence. Licence: GNU AGPL v3.0 for the open-source files, read from the repository licence file; commercial licences and technical support are offered by NewPlane. Caveats: Open5GS provides the core network, not the radio; contributors must accept a contributor licence agreement; the software was not built or run for this record, and the list of supported network functions was not read beyond the README and home page. Simulation uses: laboratory mobile networks and digital twins in which core functions can be failed or stressed to study service resilience, signalling capacity and recovery. Related records: UERANSIM (platform-ueransim) simulates the devices and base stations that attach to such a core, free5GC (platform-free5gc-open-source-5g-core) and Magma (platform-magma-open-source-mobile-core) are alternative cores, and srsRAN/OCUDU (platform-srsran-ocudu-open-5g-ran) provides a radio access network.
